items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: the house band at the time was the Savoy Sultans; Erskine Hawkins and Teddy Hill -- those were the house bands at the time.

ctx.x: Well, I didn't know at the time that this band that Lucky was rehearsing was really Bill Doggett's band out of Philadelphia, and the drummer with the band was Shadow Wilson, and for some reason, Shadow and Lucky didn't sort of hit it off too good, so he had a gig at the Savoy Ballroom on a Sunday night, and it was sort of like an audition between Shadow and myself.

So I would play one set and then Shadow played one set, and at the end of the night Lucky told me that I had the job. Shadow was out. Also, on that same night, Mr. Buchanan who ran the Savoy Ballroom, told Lucky that he'd meet him in the morning down at Moe Gale's office because he was gonna sign him up to a contract. And we were gonna be like one of the house bands there at the Savoy -- the house band at the time was the Savoy Sultans; Erskine Hawkins and Teddy Hill -- those were the house bands at the time.
